name: C & C Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Since 1974 C&C Manufacturing has been producers of the Mastertrack Trailer line. Let our years of expertise help you to find your perfect trailer.
about:
C & C Manufacturing Inc. is based in Gaithersburg, Maryland. Founded in 1974, the company has produced the Mastertrack trailer line for decades.

The company manufactures trailers under the Mastertrack brand and provides a full range of trailer services including repair, maintenance, and custom fabrication. Its capabilities encompass steel and aluminum welding, brake and suspension work, body component repair, and electrical system service. C & C also operates an in-stock parts department supplying axle assemblies, hydraulic and electric brake assemblies, cargo control hardware, and tow-vehicle wiring and brake-control installation.

The company's customer base includes the U.S. Navy, the U.S. Army, and the White House, which have relied on C & C for products and industry expertise. It also serves commercial and private trailer owners through its service and parts operations.

C & C emphasizes a quality-first approach to fabrication, citing its long-standing experience as a differentiator in the trailer market.
